the lipid composition and the biological activities of the sponge Ax. carteri collected from different depths of the Orissa coastal region are different.

the lipid extract of the sponge A. carteri is a potential source of bioactive fatty acids and sterols, especially from the specimen collected from depth.
the lipophilic extracts of the sponge A. carteri from depth of the Bay of the Bengal of the Orissacoast are a good source of fatty acids and sterols.
the lipids extracted from the species collected from deep water have more therapeutic potential than the species collected at shallow water.

A. carteri is a rich source of fatty acids, volatile compounds, and sterols.
the lipid extracts from the sponge A. carteri collected from shallow water showed higher antimicrobial activity than the lipid extracts of the same species collected from depth.
